newsitem.title: CHINA: China region chemical plant starts trial run.
newsitem.headline: China region chemical plant starts trial run.

text.p: A 3.0 billion yuan ($361 million) chemical plant in China's northern Inner Mongolia region has begun trial operations, the China Daily said on Tuesday.
The plant, listed as a key state project for 1996, would produce 300,000 tonnes of synthetic ammonia and 500,000 tonnes of carbamide a year, the newspaper said.
The factory would obtain raw materials from a nearby oil refinery and would be producing by the end of October, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
The project was part of Beijing's drive to narrow the gap between poorer frontier regions and booming coastal areas, it said.
